description: Synthetic code-switched audio samples generated using Intron Sahara TTS for demo and benchmarking purposes.

samples.text: Ninahisi maumivu ya kichwa na joto la mwili. I think I need to see a doctor immediately.
O ni iru ori. Mo fe lo si dokita bayi. Can you help me find a clinic nearby?
Ina dauwa da zazzaɓar jiki. Please I need urgent care, my temperature is very high.
Umariko nkuru numwe. Ndinotoda kuenda kuna dokotira nhasi. Where is the nearest hospital?
Ndi flu. Ndinokuvara mumusoro. I need some pain relievers, can you recommend something?
Ndebwe n'induru. Please help me, I need medicine for my headache.
